description: This file defines the class 'Upload' in the namespace 'Opencart.Admin.Controller.Tool'. It manages upload-related functionalities in the OpenCart admin interface, including listing uploads, deleting uploads, and downloading specific upload files. The class extends the system's Controller engine and contains methods for handling display and processing of uploads, including filtering, pagination, and permission checks.

classes.name: Upload
classes.description: Controller class for managing upload operations such as listing, deleting, and downloading uploads within the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial method to load the upload management page, setting up language, title, breadcrumbs, and view rendering.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the AJAX request to retrieve and return the list of uploads, including pagination and filtering.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for the upload list, applying filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Processes the request to delete selected upload records, including permission checks and file deletion.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Provides the functionality to download a specific upload file based on the provided code.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles the upload process: permission validation, file validation (name, type, size), moving files, and recording the upload.
